text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On our day off, Winning Ticket and I go out to watch a race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Each Umamusume on the track is following her own dream. Seeing this, Winning Ticket is encouraged to endeavor harder in her own training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, despite her newfound determination, she still struggles to make progress.
